rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Superior Electoral Court's diploma, dated Brasília 10 December 2018 and signed by Minister Rosa Weber as President, states that Jair Messias Bolsonaro was elected President of the Federative Republic of Brazil by the vote of 28 October 2018 and qualifies him for investiture before the National Congress on 1 January 2019.

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The signed termo de posse printed in the full issue records that at 15:00 on 1 January 2019, before the National Congress in joint session in the plenary of the Chamber of Deputies, Jair Messias Bolsonaro and Antônio Hamilton Martins Mourão were solemnly empossados under article 78 of the Constitution as President and Vice-President, elected on 28 October 2018 and diplomados by the TSE on 10 December 2018, for the period 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2022, and recited the commitment.
